newsitem.title: USA: Firm raises concerns over Neozyme deal.
newsitem.headline: Firm raises concerns over Neozyme deal.

text.p: Dawson-Samberg Capital Management Inc and its affiliates raised concerns Wednesday over Neozyme II Corp's agreement to be acquired by Genzyme Corp at $45 a unit in cash.

The Dawson-Samberg group, which holds a 6.91 percent stake in Neozyme, enumerated six issues which it said Neozyme and Genzyme "have not considered, or adequately considered" in determining the price and other terms of the Genzyme offer.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group contended there is a conflict of interest in the "technology valuation" of Neozyme.
